Spectators: computer_whisperer (the user, host), [gecko]u6bkep (19.24), [gecko]Covariance (16.84). His only line was '!stop' at 3:15; the user typed nothing in this game.
our_side: Two seats in the east box (ally team 1), both Armada (lobby side Random): ai 1, team 2 at H6 (9320,3829; record-1) and ai 2, team 3 at H4 (9866,2481; record-2). One Opus 5.5 medium player a seat under an Opus 5.5 high commander, all on the ~/.claude2 account; the hands Jev jev-1.14.0 with the post-rebuild layers. No session ever took a turn: all three were refused by the five-hour rate limit before the game began, so Jev played the hands' default standing text (crates/bot/src/brain/pianist/default.md) alone for the whole game.

summary: A Cape Violet game against thebluegecko, launched at 20:44:38 EDT about half a minute after the Azurite game against him ended, on the ~/.claude2 account whose five-hour window already read 0.99. All three Opus sessions (two players and the commander) were refused on their first prompt (rate_limit_event, five_hour, status rejected, 0.77 s of wall time), so no packet, plan or chat line was ever written and Jev played the hands' default standing text alone. That opening put two wind generators before the lab (0:35-0:37) on both seats; energy sat under 2% of storage from 1:12-1:14 for 46-47% of the game while 555-640 metal waited in the store, and seat 2's constructors assisted the lab instead of taking spots (2 extractors at 3:00; seat 1 had 3). Nothing of his was ever seen and no unit crossed the map; thebluegecko typed '!stop' at 3:15 and the game ended. It shows nothing about play against a person: it is an operational failure, a game with people seated on a spent account.

root.what: The game was launched on the ~/.claude2 account with no five-hour room left. The Azurite players' last rate events (20:44:01-05) read allowed_warning at 0.99, the +40 Apex rung running beside it since 20:01 was refused at 20:44:38-43, and this game's first turns were refused the same second. The launch was the avoidable moment: the other account, or waiting for the 21:20 reset. Everything after is its cost, ending with the person's '!stop' at 3:15.

Both commanders assisted the lab at its birth (0:59, 1:03), as the default text asks. The assist on the first constructor is part of why the energy store emptied at 1:12-1:14.

lens.caveats: A 3:15 game with no player turns: the instruments have nothing to read beyond the hands. No truth file, so his side is unseen. minutes.py, analyze_match.py, floor.py and hands_window.py read the first record only (seat 1, H6). Seat 2's numbers come from jev-2.jsonl, record-2 and bot.log, counted by the reader. wake_read.py failed: it hard-codes strategist-0.jsonl, and this game's seats are 1 and 2. pro_baseline.py was not run (not Comet). No ledger row, so the build is inferred from git log. The reason for '!stop' is not in the chat. The main session's memory lists this game as '(no record)', but record-1 and record-2 exist.

open_questions: Why did thebluegecko stop at 3:15? Did the user tell him out of game, or did he see the side idle? No chat line says.
Should run/human_game.sh refuse to start, or pick the other account, when the five-hour window reads near its limit? The Azurite transcripts' allowed_warning 0.99 would have caught this one.
Should the side say in chat when its sessions stop? The person sat through three minutes of a side playing its default text with no word.
Is the hands' default text worth tuning as a fallback (two winds then the lab, energy at zero by 1:12; seat 2's constructors assisting instead of expanding), or is a game without players always void?
